quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 1,512,571 million (+3.8%), operating profit JPY 101,039 million (+7.9%; JPY 93,612 million the year before), ordinary profit JPY 119,239 million (+2.9%), net profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 103,959 million (-6.1%). Segment sales / segment profit (operating margin): Smart Communication JPY 750,378 million (+4.9%) / JPY 40,002 million (+15.4%; 5.3%); Life & Healthcare JPY 512,349 million (+3.3%) / JPY 37,260 million (+56.6%; 7.3%); Electronics JPY 251,804 million (+1.6%) / JPY 50,702 million (-11.6%; margin 20.1%, down from 23.2%). Sales by customer location: Japan JPY 1,130,423 million, Asia (China, South Korea, Taiwan, Indonesia) JPY 258,294 million, other regions (USA, France, Germany, Poland) JPY 123,853 million. No external customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 1,512,571 million (+3.8%); operating profit JPY 101,039 million (+7.9%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report, management's analysis): Digital Interface rose YoY - OLED metal masks benefited from the large metal masks for G8-size glass substrates produced at Kurosaki Plant (Fukuoka) since May 2024, but demand fell in Q4 as mid- to low-end smartphone production was cut because of the semiconductor memory shortage; display optical films were firm on larger LCD TV panels and the 2,500 mm wide coating line that began production at Mihara Plant (Hiroshima) in September 2025. Semiconductor-related sales rose YoY on a firm market and business expansion through aggressive investment, and DNP continues to expand into cutting-edge areas such as EUV lithography photomasks and nanoimprint. Segment profit fell 11.6% to JPY 50,702 million because of foreign exchange and higher fixed costs from capital and development investment in semiconductor photomasks. Segment depreciation JPY 17,879 million, segment assets JPY 410,897 million (+6.5%), investment in equity-method affiliates JPY 149,669 million; Electronics production JPY 235,341 million (+3.1%).
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics segment profit JPY 50,702 million (-11.6%); segment assets JPY 410,897 million (+6.5%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): JPY 87,743 million, mainly plants and equipment for the high-growth Digital Interface and semiconductor businesses - Electronics JPY 31,223 million (high-end photomask production equipment, and a new ultra-wide optical-film line for larger, higher-function display panels); Smart Communication JPY 25,432 million (replacing aged information-security equipment and utilities, disaster measures); Life & Healthcare JPY 22,864 million (added lines for the solar-cell encapsulant capacity expansion). Planned: the Digital Interface manufacturing facility at Kurosaki Plant (Kitakyushu), total JPY 18,200 million, JPY 14,619 million already paid, funded from own funds, started April 2022, completion January 2028 (its main equipment began operating in the first half of the year to March 2025). No significant sales or disposals of facilities are planned. Group depreciation JPY 52,815 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 87,743 million (Electronics JPY 31,223 million); Kurosaki facility JPY 18,200 million, completion January 2028

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics R&D (annual securities report): to accelerate materials for next-generation semiconductor packages DNP set up a pilot line for TGV (through-glass via) glass-core substrates at Kuki Plant (Saitama), which began operating in December 2025, to verify mass production of glass-substrate technology combining fine wiring and high flatness; it began supplying customer samples in early 2026 (high-quality samples from January 2026) and aims at early commercialisation through joint evaluation with semiconductor makers, then a mass-production system. DNP invested in Rapidus to support a domestic mass-production base for next-generation semiconductors and to widen its own Electronics business opportunities, pursuing technical collaboration on package materials and manufacturing processes from R&D through mass production with the aim of future product adoption. Its first overseas R&D site opened in the Netherlands in September 2025; the first theme is co-packaged optics (optical materials and precision processing), aiming eventually to supply more high-value semiconductor package materials.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics R&D JPY 13,218 million; TGV glass-core pilot line running since December 2025

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Group R&D, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): JPY 42,277 million, of which JPY 18,095 million for the three segments and JPY 24,181 million for headquarters development units. Smart Communication (JPY 2,546 million): a generative-AI research service using virtual consumers, an IC card that matches the user's fingerprint inside the card, a digital-passport data-linkage platform for tourism and medical services, a cloud service for clinical-trial documents and a new Ki-Re-i ID-photo booth model. Life & Healthcare (JPY 2,330 million): a mono-material PP film for pharmaceutical PTP packaging, a compact high-visibility pattern light (from June 2025), battery-pouch integration with DNP High Performance Materials Hikone (formerly Resonac Packaging) to keep and expand the top share, higher solar-encapsulant capacity and reliability plus a reflective sheet; a second overseas R&D site opened in India in April 2026 for joint research with IIT Hyderabad in mobility and medical / healthcare.
quarterly_data.figure: Group R&D JPY 42,277 million (segments JPY 18,095 million; headquarters JPY 24,181 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Smart Communication and Life & Healthcare, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report): photo-print materials grew in Western and Asian markets on demand related to new printers and ID-card ink ribbons were firm; information security rose on large BPO projects although dual-interface IC cards declined; DNP signed on June 17, 2025 to acquire 75% of Rubicon SEZC (government ID enrolment and authentication services, mainly in Africa, under the Laxton brand) and consolidated it on July 2, 2025. Battery pouches for IT devices grew on new products, while automotive pouches fell as EV sales dropped after US policy changes; solar-cell encapsulant sales rose with a new line at Izumizaki Plant (Fukushima), installed in October 2025, that roughly doubles capacity; automotive decorative films grew, a capital and business alliance with Turing Inc. targets products and services for fully autonomous driving, and the mobility and living-space businesses were merged in October 2025; packaging grew (paper cups, tube containers, aseptic filling systems for PET bottles) despite consumer purchase restraint from January 2026; medical packaging, drug-substance and drug-product businesses and beverages also grew.
quarterly_data.figure: Rubicon SEZC 75% acquired (consolidated July 2, 2025); Izumizaki encapsulant line about doubles capacity (October 2025)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Photomask and package affiliates (annual securities report): consolidated subsidiary DNP Photomask Europe S.p.A. (Agrate Brianza, Italy; 80.6% owned) makes and sells semiconductor photomasks; equity-method affiliates Photronics DNP Mask Corporation (Hsinchu, Taiwan; 49.9%) and Photronics DNP Mask Corporation Xiamen (China; 49.9%) make and sell semiconductor photomasks, and DNP supplies them electronic precision components. Shinko Electric Industries (plastic and metal packages; 15.0% of voting rights) is an equity-method affiliate: JICC-04, an equity-method affiliate of DNP, acquired Shinko, merged with it on December 1, 2025 and took the Shinko Electric Industries name.
